sample_unit: single-turn Q&A items (DoctorFLAN-test); plus 74 multi-turn conversations (DotaBench)
unlisted_practices: Repositioning LLMs as doctor-facing clinical assistants rather than patient-facing tools
Fine-tuning open-source LLMs on workflow-aligned clinician task datasets
Surveying physicians to identify clinical workflow needs for LLM tasks

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates benchmarks (DoctorFLAN-test and DotaBench) aligned with clinical workflows based on physician surveys, but primarily tests model performance rather than evaluating a specific deployment practice/guardrail.
